analysis: The PR changes only a test file: LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift. It adds `@testable import MLXLLM` (head line 2) and a new test, forwardsGDNPromptKernelRollbackToProviderJob (head lines 236-258). The test asserts that the GatedDeltaPrefill.envFlag rollback key is in LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys. It also asserts the key is not in WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys, that unrelated env vars (UNRELATED_SECRET) are not forwarded into the plist, and that the launchd-resolved mode matches the foreground mode. No production code changed, so no new attack surface, auth, attestation, encryption or data-exposure behavior is introduced here. The test reinforces an allowlist-based environment passthrough, which is consistent with the TB-003 and TB-007 posture of not leaking arbitrary shell environment into the daemon plist. The passthrough key itself is a performance/correctness rollback knob (GDN prompt kernel), not a secret or a trust-affecting control, and the test constrains it to the provider job only. Unverified from the supplied evidence: whether the production allowlist change that adds GatedDeltaPrefill.envFlag to inferencePassthroughEnvKeys exists in this PR or in another batch, and whether the MLXLLM module's GatedDeltaPrefill is correct. Those are outside this unit. No threat-model entries need updating from this test-only change.
